specs.Picture Quality Enhancement Technology: Acer ComfyView, Acer Vision Care (Bluelight Shield, Flickerless)

features: 【🔥 Ultra-Smooth 120Hz Full HD Display】Experience stunning clarity on a 21.5" FHD (1920×1080) VA panel with 120Hz refresh rate, delivering ultra-smooth motion for work, movies, and casual gaming. Enjoy sharper visuals with reduced motion blur.

【⚡ 1ms VRB + AdaptiveSync for Seamless Motion】Loaded with 1ms (VRB) and AdaptiveSync, this monitor eliminates screen tearing, stuttering, and ghosting—ensuring fluid transitions and responsive performance with every frame.

【🔌 Versatile Connectivity & Adjustable Tilt】Effortlessly connect your setup using HDMI 1.4 and VGA ports for smooth compatibility with PCs, laptops, and media devices. The ergonomic tilt range of –5° to 20° lets you adjust the screen to your perfect viewing angle, reducing neck strain and ensuring comfortable productivity in any workspace or home office environment.

【👁️ Acer VisionCare+ for All-Day Eye Comfort】Engineered for extended use, Acer’s VisionCare suite combines Flicker-less, BlueLightShield, ComfyView anti-glare, and Low-Dimming technologies to significantly reduce eye strain. Whether you're working, studying, or streaming for hours, these features ensure softer visuals, improved comfort, and healthier long-term viewing.
【🖥️ ZeroFrame Design for Immersive Viewing】The sleek ZeroFrame bezel maximizes screen space and offers a seamless multi-monitor setup, making it perfect for productivity and minimalistic desk setups.
